_comment: HUMAN-TWEAKABLE OVERLAY FOR router-config.yaml. Optional — if this file is missing, the YAML defaults apply. Anything set here overrides the YAML at load time. Delete a field to fall back to the YAML default. All fields here are optional; include only what you want to change.
_how_to_use: 1. Edit values below to experiment without touching YAML.

2. Most-common knobs: max_tier (cost cap), effort_by_task_type (Anthropic), thinking_budget_by_task_type_gemini25 (Gemini 2.5), thinking_level_by_task_type_gemini3 (Gemini 3.x when you upgrade), reasoning_effort_by_task_type_openai (GPT-5.x).
3. To disable this file entirely, rename it or delete it.
4. The router logs which overrides were applied at session start.

max_tier._comment: Hard cap on the most expensive tier the router will use for ANY task. 3 = allow Opus / GPT-5.4. 2 = cap at Sonnet / Gemini Pro / GPT-5.4 Mini (saves money, may hurt quality on architecture work). 1 = Flash only (experimental runs only).

effort_by_task_type._comment: Anthropic effort level per task type. Applied to Sonnet and Opus. Values: low | medium | high | xhigh. Maps to output_config.effort. Omit a task type to keep the YAML value. NOTE: Sonnet 4.6 defaults to HIGH internally if this is unset on the API side — so leaving it unset is the expensive choice. Explicitly setting low/medium here saves real money.

adaptive_thinking_by_task_type._comment: Whether Anthropic models use adaptive thinking per task type. true = send thinking:{type:adaptive}. false = no thinking block (fastest, cheapest). Simple tasks should be false; reasoning tasks should be true.

thinking_budget_by_task_type_gemini25._comment: Gemini 2.5 thinking budget per task type. Integer token cap. -1 = dynamic (Gemini picks). 0 = thinking off. Positive integer = hard cap. Applied when the model_id starts with 'gemini-2.5-'. NOTE: Gemini 2.5 Pro cannot have thinking fully disabled (0 is ignored).

thinking_level_by_task_type_gemini3._comment: Gemini 3.x thinking level per task type. Applied only when model_id starts with 'gemini-3'. Values: MINIMAL | LOW | MEDIUM | HIGH. MINIMAL is only valid on Flash/Flash-Lite/Flash-Image — not Pro. Gemini 3 Pro DEFAULTS TO HIGH on the API side if unset, which is expensive — explicitly set it. These values are ignored if you haven't upgraded models yet.

reasoning_effort_by_task_type_openai._comment: OpenAI GPT-5.x reasoning.effort per task type. Values: none | minimal | low | medium | high | xhigh. 'none' disables reasoning tokens entirely (fastest/cheapest). GPT-5.4 defaults to medium if unset — more expensive than 'none' or 'low' but cheaper than Anthropic's default. Reasoning tokens are billed as output tokens.

metrics._comment: Controls the global metrics log at ai-router/router-metrics.jsonl. Disable if you want to stop collecting. Retention note: log is append-only JSON lines; rotate manually when it gets large.

delegation._comment: Guidance surfaced to the orchestrator via the instruction files (CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md / GEMINI.md). These values don't change router behavior directly — they set the thresholds that the orchestrator reads when deciding whether to do work itself vs. call route().
